theta: expit(alpha_j + beta N*_t + gamma D_t), D_t = [Jan 2021, Mar 2021]; Apr 2020 pi = 0 in all variants

channels.senders: gamma in theta, count multiplier r(beta, gamma) / r(0, 0); receipt unchanged
channels.receipt: gamma as household receipt logit shift in D_t months (s and s_full)

fit: per kappa, alternating to a fixed point (|change| < 1e-4): beta = argmin quarterly log RMSE 2020Q2..2021Q4 given gamma (bounded 0..3); gamma = argmin spike RMSE (Jan/Mar 2021, log index minus mean of neighbouring months, vs Banxico) given beta

pi_profile.note: gamma_senders fitted at each pi (alternating fit as above)
